description: This file implements distributed leader election logic using etcd client v3, including election creation, campaigning, proclaiming, resigning, observing leader changes, and retrieving leader info.

classes.name: Election
classes.description: Represents a distributed election instance managing leader election state and operations.

methods.name: NewElection
methods.description: Creates a new Election object for a given session and key prefix.

methods.name: ResumeElection
methods.description: Resumes an election with a known leader key and revision.

methods.name: Campaign
methods.description: Participates in the election as a candidate with a specified value.

methods.name: Proclaim
methods.description: Leader announces a new value without re-electing.

methods.name: Resign
methods.description: Leader resigns, starting a new election.

methods.name: Leader
methods.description: Retrieves the current leader's key and revision.

methods.name: Observe
methods.description: Returns a channel to observe leader changes.

methods.name: Rev
methods.description: Returns the creation revision of the leader key.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Returns the response header from the last successful election operation.
